title: OKG deployment.yaml
description: Top-level manifest for an OKG deployment. Generated by scripts/gen_deployment_schema.py from okg.substrate.deployments.keys.DEPLOYMENT_KEYS; do not edit by hand. A block is closed only where the code that parses it refuses unknown keys.

agent_surface.description: The declared agent surface: served operators, response budget, per-client projections and live bindings.

agent_tools.description: Deployment-declared MCP tools, by tool name.

alias_resolver.description: Alias resolver backends for the publish stack; absent or empty uses the default resolver.

aliases.description: Path to the deployment's alias file (aliases.json), composed into the catalog.

audit_questions.description: Path to a text file served verbatim in the MCP read-side metadata.

chat.description: The governed chat site for this deployment.

checkpoint_attestor_root.description: Directory holding the checkpoint attestor implementations.

checkpoint_attestors.description: Checkpoint attestors the publisher runs, each {id, class, config}.

chronos.description: Graph history storage tuning and history retention.

history_retention.description: How long superseded graph history is kept; parsed strictly by okg.substrate.history_compaction.parse_history_retention.

interval_continuation_percent.description: Percent (1-99) of an interval's rows that must continue for the store to extend it in place.

citation_attr.description: The record attribute a reader cites (for example a benchmark document id); search rows and inspect node and text reads name it.

code_drift.description: Code-drift check policy: mode (track_base or pinned), and for track_base an optional base_ref and max_commits_behind.

base_ref.description: track_base only: the ref to compare with.

max_commits_behind.description: track_base only: classify staleness past this.

mode.description: track_base follows base_ref; pinned requires the sync root at the installed okg build and, for a submodule, at the superproject's committed pin.

consistency.description: Publish consistency policy (dangling_edges, resolution_aware_reuse, defer_dangling_edges, max_deferred_edges_per_run, max_deferred_edge_fraction, deferred_cap_mode, max_deferred_edges_unpublished_owner, deferred_edge_warn_after).

consistency_gates.description: Frozen SQL consistency gates run at publish (deprecated path).

contract.description: Deployment lifecycle contract: version, lifecycle, owner, usage.

coverage.description: Declared known coverage gaps, echoed by inspect(coverage).

dashboards.description: Path to supervisor-console dashboards; nothing reads it.

deployment_up.description: `okg deployment up` policy: backup, restore drill and budgets.

derived_producers.description: Authority policies for derived extractor and enricher producers.

description.description: One-line description shown by `okg deployment show`.

docker.description: Compose stack written by `okg install`: compose_path, project_name and host_port, read by `okg start`, `okg stop` and `okg restart`.

doctor_checks.description: Deployment doctor checks, each {name, handler, help}.

edge_precedence.description: Producer ranking for edge types several producers write: {edge_type: [highest-ranked producer, ..., lowest]}. The graph stores the highest-ranked declarer's version of such an edge.

embedding.description: Deprecated spelling of `embeddings`; loads with a warning.

embeddings.description: Whether and with which backend the deployment embeds nodes.

enricher_registry.description: Path to an enricher registry file; nothing reads its content.

enrichers.description: Enrichers the publisher runs, each {class, config, authority}.

live_capabilities.description: Path to a live-capabilities file; nothing reads it.

mcp.description: MCP tool profiles that bound the served tool surface.

commit_nodes.description: true: the deployment holds commit: nodes (for example from its own source module that wraps GitHistorySource), so the instructions name them. false: they are left out. Absent: inferred from the source registry.

dataset_card.description: false: the server neither gathers nor serves the dataset card. Absent means true.

doc_text_nodes.description: true: the deployment holds file-text doc: nodes (for example from its own source module that wraps DocCorpusSource), so the instructions point at them. false: they are left out. Absent: inferred from the source registry.

file_nodes.description: true: the deployment holds file: nodes (for example from its own source module that wraps a git source), so the instructions name them and show source_file lookups. false: they are left out. Absent: inferred from the source registry.

mcp_instructions.description: Path to the MCP server instructions file.

mcp_pre_join_tools.description: Path to pre-join tool declarations; nothing in production reads it.

mcp_trace_path.description: Path for MCP traces; nothing reads it.

module_providers.description: Owner-to-directory map adding ontology module providers.

modules.description: Ontology modules the catalog composes, as module references.

modules_config.description: Per-module settings read by the deployment's own code.

name.description: Deployment name; defaults to the directory name.

native_views.description: Native view refresh policy for the publisher.

nomos.description: Nomos posture, enforcement and authentication settings.

not_ingested.description: Short phrases naming what the deployment did not ingest; the MCP dataset card states them.

post_publish_consistency_checks.description: Post-publish SQL consistency checks (frozen SQL path).

database.description: Expected database name, checked against the DSN's target.

dsn.description: Postgres DSN literal or ${ENV_VAR} reference; the value every database command connects with.

idle_in_transaction_session_timeout_ms.description: How long one of this deployment's Postgres sessions may sit idle inside a transaction before the server ends it, in milliseconds. Omit for okg's default (300000); 0 disables the bound. OKG_IDLE_IN_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT_MS overrides it per process.

self_hosted_authoritative.description: Marks a self-hosted local profile as the database authority.

profile.description: The install profile that wrote this deployment (name, version, answers).

publisher.description: Publisher statement timeout, lock headroom and first-publish budget.

allow_raised_statement_timeout.description: Whether release proof may judge headroom against a deployment timeout above the 900-second compatibility bound.

first_publish_warning_budget.description: Inclusive effective-row thresholds that warn after the first authoritative count and before cold publication stages.

hard_statement_timeout_seconds.description: Hard timeout in seconds for each statement executed while the publisher lock is held.

lock_hold_headroom_factor.description: Required ratio between the hard timeout and measured publisher lock hold.

max_source_sync_yield_seconds.description: How long, in seconds, the scheduled publisher yields to queued or running source syncs after its last fresh publish. Once the newest of its last non-skipped cycle and the branch's newest published generation is older, the cycle publishes past sync workflow rows (a run still writing, a held admission intent and the publish lock still hold it back). Default 600.

readiness.description: Readiness profile (`profile`: dogfood, ci or standard), source-group overrides and source-optimization policy.

record_prefixes.description: Record prefixes the MCP record tool offers.

release.description: Release contract: channel, kind and pin.

resolvers.description: Pre-join resolver declarations; nothing in production reads them.

runtime.description: Worker runtime: pools, schedules, workflows and source sync.

schema_dir.description: Directory of the deployment's own schema files. Required.

session_start_context.description: Slices the MCP session-start payload renders.

skill_triggers.description: Path to per-subtype skill hints for the MCP server.

skills_dir.description: Directory of skill files hashed into the release pin.

snapshot_path.description: Path to a snapshot; nothing reads it.

source_registry.description: Path to the source registry. Required.

sync_root.description: Repository root for file-derived sources: a path, path anchor or ${VAR}.

taxonomy.description: Path to a taxonomy file; nothing reads its content.

tool_description_overrides.description: Path to per-tool description overrides for the chat projection.

viz_path.description: Path to a separate console settings file; nothing reads it.
